office: the General Directorate of Population and Citizenship Affairs (Nüfus ve Vatandaşlık İşleri Genel Müdürlüğü)
note: The total is the passport duty (harç) by the validity chosen plus the booklet price (defter bedeli, 1,351 TL) for 2026, the duties raised 18.95% rather than by the 25.49% revaluation rate, as Milliyet reported them on 7 January 2026 from the communiqué in the Resmî Gazete (resmigazete.gov.tr times out from here and gib.gov.tr's copy wasn't found; not read). Any validity over three years pays the same duty, so the ten-year passport stands for them; the six-month passport (4,157.50 TL in all) isn't modelled. Exemptions, limits by age, processing times and consular fees abroad are leads.

sources.title: Milliyet, 2026 Pasaport harç ücretleri! 6 aylık 1-2-3 ve 10 yıllık Pasaport harç ücreti ne kadar oldu? (7 January 2026)
